title: DNS: Note and dissect any extraneous payload bytes
description:
DNS packets in the wild sometimes include extraneous trailing
data in the DNS payload that Wireshark currently ignores. This issue
was mentioned in a thread on the dns-operations email list in a recent
message[1] that included a two packet sample pcap of same.

This patch updates the DNS dissector to note and partially
dissect (as bytes) any extraneous trailing bytes in the DNS payload.

[1] https://lists.dns-oarc.net/pipermail/dns-operations/2022-May/021657.html

Closes #18154
